candidate.text: Add `CAInjectorMerging` feature gate to the ca-injector, enabling this will change the behavior of the ca-injector to merge in new CA certificates instead of outright replacing the existing one. (#7469, @ThatsMrTalbot)

evidence.excerpt: - Add `CAInjectorMerging` feature gate to the ca-injector, enabling this will change the behavior of the ca-injector to merge in new CA certificates instead of outright replacing the existing one. ([#7469](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/7469), [@ThatsMrTalbot](https://github.com/ThatsMrTalbot))
